items.title: Houston Person Part 2 interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, October 2, 1998 [interview 2 of 2]
items.q: I heard Bob Mintzer’s band this summer, it was great.

ctx.x: It seems to be. I keep seeing these little articles in the paper, swing is coming back.
Oh yeah. And I heard Bob Mintzer’s band this summer, it was great. So guys are out there.

Well in your career as a recording musician, we mentioned you’ve recorded some seventy-some albums. Does the economics, has it changed a lot over the years? Trying to get records, out, keeping track of how they’re doing? Has your relationship with record companies changed?
